advice.msg: `var` is outside the subset; use let or const
advice.do: [conditional: the binding is inside a function, has one declaration, every use follows it in the same block, and no closure inside a loop captures it] Replace var with let only under the precondition. Hoisting, repeated declarations and loop closures can change the result.

advice.msg: `schemaValidator` is module state that can change; the subset reads constants only
advice.do: [migration] This name cannot be resolved in the project; a proof needs its type. advice.msg: the callback must be an arrow function
advice.do: [conditional: the function has no `this`, `arguments` or `new.target` in it and is never called with `new`] The callback must be an arrow function with plain parameters. A named function is read by name when its own parameters are plain; otherwise pass it the arguments JavaScript passes, `xs.map((x, i, a) => f(x, i, a))`, or only the ones it reads. An effectful callback may destructure its element or default it where the element type never holds undefined; name the fields you read instead of a rest element.
